## Metagenome Assembly

This workshop investigates the microbial community associated
with black band disease in the coral *Acropora hyacinthus*.

Long-read metagenomic sequencing data were assembled using Flye.
To avoid repeating the computationally intensive assembly, I
used the instructor-provided Flye results.

### Accessing the assembly

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/flye
ln -s /pvol/data/mg/bbd/flye/bbd .
```

The symbolic link provides access to the precomputed assembly
without duplicating the sequencing data.

The resulting assembled contigs provide the starting point for
genome binning and subsequent taxonomic and functional analyses.
